candidate_followups.findings: UNEP still uses annual framing; the Science abstract concerns plastic waste generated in 2016. A direct citation relationship was not established.
remaining_concerns: Reference-year scope and possible common estimate remain unresolved; no two-source independence assumed.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Retain the exact attributed claim. Explain separately that the research abstract estimates 2016 and that its relationship to the UNEP annual summary remains unverified.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Hold for temporal-scope review; do not treat matching ranges as independent contemporary measurements.

candidate_followups.findings: The original defining-constants URL still times out. Accessible official BIPM brochure section 1.1 directly defines the SI using seven constants; the operative resolution takes effect 20 May 2019.
remaining_concerns: Original URL and excerpt remain unverified. Replacement has not been adopted. Publication day remains unknown; shared BIPM origin is not independent corroboration.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Propose replacing the inaccessible evidence with the official English SI Brochure, section 1.1 (printed page 121 / PDF page 11), preserving its actual wording and edition/version. Use the resolution operative decision rather than only its 2011 considering clause.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Prepare a versioned context/source revision, then obtain a genuine human inclusion decision. Current candidate is not silently repaired.

candidate_followups.findings: The reopened WMO quotation and Paris Agreement section explicitly state the annual-versus-long-term distinction. The omitted context is identifiable.
remaining_concerns: Saved evidence is still only a trailing clause. Any expanded frozen context requires a versioned candidate review; no new claim wording was selected.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Proposed source-context paraphrase, not a quotation: WMO distinguishes a single year above 1.5°C from assessment of Paris long-term warming goals over decades; annual exceedance alone does not establish failure of that goal.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Prepare a versioned context/source revision, then obtain a genuine human inclusion decision. Current candidate is not silently repaired.

candidate_followups.findings: The conditional 2023 estimate has a 2037–2109 interval; the 2025 modelling announcement describes collapse as unlikely this century. Neither establishes an unconditional before-2100 event.
remaining_concerns: Different methods/scenarios are not automatically a genuine contradiction. Claim lacks as-of conditions; full model and data independence were not audited.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Keep a future proposition under test separate from attributed model projections. Human coordinator must decide the intended temporal/scenario scope before preparing a fixed annotation bundle.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Hold for scope and comparability review; do not force a prediction or replace the claim with a different proposition.

candidate_followups.findings: The 2019 quotation is explicitly limited-information language. A 2022 WHO publication overview reviews evidence through December 2021 and still identifies research uncertainties.
remaining_concerns: No present-day harmlessness demonstration was established. The full 2022 report and later research were not exhaustively reviewed. Missing proof of harmlessness does not establish harm.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Restore the 2019 uncertainty qualification as context. Any later WHO overview is a separate dated supplementary source, not a replacement date for the original passage.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Hold as insufficient evidence for the categorical present-day proposition, or deliberately include a limited bundle only after an explicit human protocol decision.

candidate_followups.findings: The same OTP sentence appears in both single- and multi-factor sections. Section 3.1.5 explicitly defines multi-factor OTP and states the relevant limitation.
remaining_concerns: Saved excerpt lacks its section heading. Shared NIST URL with p1-tech-004 must remain grouped; original day is still unknown.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Proposed context locator: NIST SP 800-63B-4, section 3.1.5 Multi-Factor OTPs. Preserve the definition requiring an activation factor and identify this occurrence of the saved sentence, not the single-factor occurrence.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Prepare a versioned context/source revision, then obtain a genuine human inclusion decision. Current candidate is not silently repaired.

candidate_followups.findings: Oxford names Marie Curie in the immediately preceding sentence, resolving the pronoun. Three attempted official Nobel resources returned 403 and were not verified.
remaining_concerns: Saved fragment still omits its antecedent. Double negation is collector-authored. Official award-record corroboration was blocked, not assumed.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Proposed context note, not a quotation: the pronoun in the Oxford passage refers to Marie Curie, named in the preceding sentence. Retain that antecedent in any expanded versioned excerpt.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Prepare a versioned context/source revision, then obtain a genuine human inclusion decision. Current candidate is not silently repaired.

candidate_followups.findings: The original Europa page and an official mission FAQ discuss possible habitability. The FAQ explicitly says Europa Clipper is not a life-detection mission.
remaining_concerns: No life-detection evidence was established. This is not proof that no life exists. A habitability goal cannot supply a directional life-existence assessment.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Keep the mission goal separate from the existence claim. Include this fixed insufficient bundle only if the human coordinator intentionally approves that research design.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Hold as insufficient evidence; do not manufacture either supporting evidence or an absence-of-life conclusion.

candidate_followups.findings: The original question 99 identifies the Great Wall. A separate official NASA Earth-observation FAQ names it explicitly and addresses visibility from the Moon.
remaining_concerns: Original archive answer date and new FAQ publication day are unknown. Same NASA institution does not provide independent corroboration; Moon, orbit and photographic visibility must remain separate.
candidate_followups.proposed_context_note: Proposed context note, not a quotation: the pronoun in Cosmicopia answer 99 refers to the Great Wall of China named in its question. The supplementary NASA FAQ can provide a named-subject source if a replacement is versioned and reviewed.
candidate_followups.recommended_inclusion_action: Prepare a versioned context/source revision, then obtain a genuine human inclusion decision. Current candidate is not silently repaired.
